name: l33-forced-stride
why: L33 step 2: Avowed resolves GObjects by AOB (GOBJ_AV1, build 1238) and never reaches the forced static-stride path. Skip the AOB winner's Aura::Init so Count==0 -- the recovery's own trigger -- and Genau::FindGObjectsStaticStruct + Aura::InitWithExtendedLayout run on the real Obsidian 20-byte layout. Built as the dxgi PROXY: Avowed loads ours by name.
